Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely identified Frank Skinner as “the composer” of The Merry Monahans based on a search-results snippet without opening authoritative pages (e.g., Wikipedia/IMDb) to verify full music credits. This locked the workflow onto Frank Skinner’s biography and death place (Hollywood/Beverly Hills) instead of checking Hans J. Salter—who is credited with the film’s music and died in Studio City—leading the team down the wrong path.
